events.title: Eco Park Wildlife Awareness & Rescue Drive
events.description: Hands-on community workshop covering injured wildlife response and rescue safety.
events.long_description: Join our certified wildlife rescue team for an immersive outdoor training session at Eco Park. Learn to safely handle birds of prey, small mammals, and urban wildlife emergencies.

events.title: Wildlife Rescue Camp
events.description: Join wildlife experts and rescue injured animals in a hands-on camp.
events.long_description: This intensive weekend camp is designed for animal lovers who want to learn real-world rescue techniques. You will shadow senior veterinarians, participate in rehabilitation sessions for raptors, and learn how to safely transport injured mammals. All equipment and basic meals provided.
events.refund_policy: Full refund available up to 48 hours before the event.

events.title: International Dog Exhibition
events.description: Showcase dog breeds, participate in competitions, meet breeders.
events.long_description: The biggest canine event of the year! Over 500 breeds on display, agility competitions, grooming workshops, and stalls from the top pet care brands in Asia. Special sessions on advanced obedience using AI tracking tools. Tickets include a goodie bag for your pet.
events.refund_policy: 80% refundable until 24h before. No refunds on the day of event.

events.title: National Adoption Drive
events.description: Adopt a rescued dog or cat and give them a loving forever home.
events.long_description: Find your new best friend at our monthly adoption drive. Over 50 dogs and cats from various shelters will be present. All animals are vaccinated, dewormed, and microchipped. Adoption counselors will be on site to help you find the perfect match for your lifestyle.

events.title: Bird Conservation Seminar
events.description: Expert talks on endangered bird species conservation and habitat protection.
events.long_description: A gathering of ornithologists and conservationists to discuss the state of migratory birds in South India. Topics include wetland protection, pesticide impacts, and how citizen scientists can contribute to bird counts using the EcoTrack app.

events.title: AI Animal Training Workshop
events.description: Learn AI-powered training techniques for pets and wild animals.
events.long_description: Discover how advanced techniques are revolutionizing animal training. This workshop covers the basics of behavioral correction, focus training, and monitoring rehabilitation progress in injured animals.
events.refund_policy: 50% Refundable. No-show will not be refunded.
